_comment: Live classroom (/live/ and /live/screen/). One QR code for the whole course; the lecturer starts a class on the screen. For each lesson: 'sections' (at most 7) are the choices for 'where did you first get lost?' in a lecture check-in; 'polls' are opened from the screen at the matching slide. A poll is a choice (2-8 options) or, with "kind": "text", a one-sentence answer. Results show live unless "showLive": false. "answer" (0-based) marks the correct option, shown when the lecturer reveals; omit it for a decision with no single right answer. 'workshops' are the optional assessment workshops: chosen in the same lesson menu, with no lecture/lab choice; their polls are two-way 'where next?' votes the lecturer opens as the class asks.
